# Review - PR 582 @ feb7ff9b23c2056d3de6f7d03b017b1e46a0848e

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 5b42da0ed6d42cc3009f4046e454528db11c68d9. Bounded update assessment of a refreshed documentation-only head: the main-relative change is now two blueprint chapters (+103/-11), one file and one hunk fewer than the head already approved.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Base is `main`. Reviewed the published head `feb7ff9b` against `base=e298786d226956e9a659415a1cc6ab40fafe0f27` (its merge base with `github/main` at `5b42da0e`). The branch carries three commits since that base: the content commit `8a0f5846` and two merges of `github/main`, the later of which is this head.

(a) Current diff at the exact head. `git diff e298786d feb7ff9b` touches exactly two files: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch14_qpbt_observables.tex` (+4/-5) and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex` (+99/-6). No Lean, script, audit or telemetry file is touched.

(b) Coverage by the existing approval 5240954561 (head `9bd12f2d`), hunk by hunk.
- Both blueprint patches are byte-identical to the approved ones. I recomputed the main-relative patch payload (all added and removed lines, excluding file headers and line-number ranges) for each file at both heads and compared them independently: `ch14` 572 bytes, SHA-256 `2a47e7adbdf580a3a5b4fed40220a49d4fb6becd18124324b9e71094f3a5b062` at both heads; `ch15` 5303 bytes, SHA-256 `42cf0435c52b3f968072e5864a20d6533ef14dc883bd55f9e070547fb0280c79` at both heads; `diff` of the two payload files is empty in each case. Only the hunk headers moved (`ch14` 1805 -> 1812, `ch15` 848 -> 856, 895 -> 1008, 1195 -> 1592, 1209 -> 1608), which is the expected effect of rebasing onto a `main` that has since grown above these positions.
- One approved hunk is gone: the module-docstring change in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean` ("states the construction obligation" -> "constructs the projective joint X/Z point measurements"). I verified this is an already-on-main delta, not a withdrawal: `git diff github/main feb7ff9b -- MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean` is empty, and the docstring on `github/main` carries the new wording. The branch therefore no longer needs to carry it, and the reviewed contribution is intact.
- No hunk is added, enlarged or reordered relative to the approved head. Strict whole-patch identity with `9bd12f2d` is consequently FALSE, and the single reason is the removal of the redundant `Points.lean` hunk.

(c) Faithfulness at this head. The change is prose-only, so no theorem statement or definition is weakened or strengthened; `git grep` for `sorry`, `admit`, a top-level `axiom` and `native_decide` over both touched files returns only ordinary English uses of "admits". All eight `\lean` targets of the two touched nodes resolve at this head: `opFamilyDistSq_uniform_le_four`, `sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one`, its primed variant, `ProjectiveSetting.chain_bounds` and `error_terms_le_rpow_eighth` in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Closeness.lean` (lines 47, 87, 116, 141, 225), and `ProjectiveSetting.combinedLineMeasurement_effect_eq_pastedMeasurement` / `_axis_degree_X` / `_axis_degree_Z` in `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/CombinedMeasurement.lean` (lines 65, 75, 85); none of those two files contains `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`. I re-checked the two substantive prose claims against the Lean at this head rather than inheriting them: the four items of `lem:combined-point-distance-support` match their targets including every hypothesis and the exact constants `(2,4,4)`, `(4,8,8,2)`, `(12,20,16,4)` of `chain_bounds`, and the new orientation sentence matches `combinedLineMeasurement_effect_eq_pastedMeasurement`, whose statement is exactly `effect (fX,fZ) = pastedMeasurement (Z-line effect) (X-line effect) fZ fX` with an `rfl` proof, so the exchanged outcome order is asserted and no consistency estimate is. The remark that admissibility does not require `md<q` is correct against `AdmissibleParams` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/PauliBasisTest.lean:37-43`, whose only constraints are `1 <= d`, `IsAdmissibleSize q` and `m | q`). All twelve `\label` targets referenced by the added text resolve to exactly one definition each, and the paper locators in the cited docstrings (`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:943-961` and `:949`) are unchanged by this PR.

(d) Exact-head CI at `feb7ff9b`: combined state success, 9 of 9 contexts success - `local-ci/summary`, `build`, `blueprint-render`, `blueprint-sync`, `paper-gaps`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion`, `statement-origin`. Mergeable state is clean.

Prior findings: the only earlier marked review of this PR is approval 5240954561 at `9bd12f2d`, with zero unchecked findings, so there is nothing outstanding to re-check.

Not checked: I ran no build of my own (read-only session, primary checkout quiet window); elaboration of the `\lean` targets rests on the green exact-head `local-ci/build`, and no Lean file changes at this head in any case. I did not re-derive the untouched `main`-side proofs that these blueprint nodes link to beyond the signatures compared above, and I did not re-audit the parts of the approved head that this head reproduces byte for byte beyond confirming that identity.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
